scenarios.hypothesis: RDS failover of orders-payments-db caused payments-service to fail readiness probes and be removed from service mesh routing, making it unreachable to orders-service and blocking checkout completion.

Deployment of commit a1b2c3d ('refactor payment validation') introduced a NullPointerException in PaymentValidator.validate() due to missing null-safety checks, causing 34% of checkout requests to fail immediately.

O recommendation-service possui um memory leak ativo que causa crescimento monotônico de memória de ~180Mi para ~510Mi em ciclos de ~2h30m, excedendo o limite configurado de 512Mi e resultando em OOMKills recorrentes.
